title: RoboThink: Let the Agent Think, Let the Policy Act
abstract: arXiv:2611.30111v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot policies act in real time but fail without knowing why, whereas a reasoning agent that watches the robot can often tell what went wrong. Existing systems either hand the agent control, which takes minutes per episode, or let it send instructions. Yet a policy follows a new instruction only from a fresh start, since a half-finished task leaves it in states outside its training data. Nor can an instruction fix how the robot moves. If a drift keeps pulling the hand to the left, "push right, slightly" is not a task the policy has learned. We propose RoboThink, in which the agent thinks and the policy learns to act on the agent's guidance. An instruction channel tells the policy what to do. When the user says "the milk, not the butter" after the robot has started, the agent rewrites the instruction and the robot undoes its own motion, with no training. A feedback channel tells it how to move. It is taught from the agent alone with age

translated_title: RoboThink：让智能体思考，让策略行动
translated_abstract: 机器人策略能够实时执行动作，但失败时却不知道原因，而一个观察机器人的推理智能体通常能指出哪里出了问题。现有系统要么让智能体直接接管控制（每个回合需要数分钟），要么让它发送指令。然而，策略只有在从头开始时才会遵循新指令，因为完成一半的任务会使它处于训练数据之外的状态。指令也无法修正机器人的运动方式——如果漂移持续把手拉向左侧，“向右轻推一点”并不是策略学过的任务。我们提出 RoboThink：智能体负责思考，策略学习根据智能体的引导来行动。一条指令通道告诉策略该做什么——当机器人在任务启动后，用户说出“要牛奶，不要黄油”时，智能体会重写指令，机器人便撤销自己的动作，无需任何训练。一条反馈通道告诉策略该如何移动，它仅由智能体来教授（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出RoboThink框架，让推理智能体通过指令通道和反馈通道引导机器人策略，使机器人能在任务中途修正目标、撤销错误动作并调整运动方式，而无需额外训练。
en_tdlr: RoboThink enables a reasoning agent to guide a robot policy via instruction and feedback channels, allowing mid-task goal correction, motion undoing, and movement adjustment without retraining.
